title: Down the Hole
blurb: Doc has found the main tunnel the hive climbs out of. Ride down with the railroad's old dynamite, set charges deep inside, light the fuse and get back up the rope before it blows.

telegram.title: Shut the Front Door
telegram.body: MAIN TUNNEL FOUND STOP THE HIVE COMES UP THROUGH IT STOP DYNAMITE WAITING AT THE ROPE FOOT STOP CARRY IT IN AND SET A CHARGE AT EVERY MARK STOP LIGHT THE FUSE AT THE MOUTH THEN CLIMB STOP DO NOT DAWDLE STOP

build: I've found where they come up. The big tunnel. It breathes, ranchers. Warm and wet.
So we shut its front door. Dynamite's at the rope foot. Down you go.
That's railroad dynamite. Older than Pearl's jokes. Carry it like a sleeping baby.
wave: Hive's furious. Every bug in the canyon wants a word. Hold the line!
held: Still standing? I'll have to pay out. Disgusting.

down: Odds of you all coming back up: fair. I've lost money on fair.
crate: Steady with that crate. It's older than you and twice as grumpy.
inside: Mind the resin. It's warm because something is still digesting in it.
hunters: They're pouring out of the tunnel! Cover whoever's carrying!
charge: One charge set. Don't run in there. Don't walk fast either.
armed: Every charge is set! Light the fuse at the mouth and run for the rope.
lit: Fuse is lit! Out of the hole and up that rope, now!
blast: Ka-BOOM. Main tunnel's sealed. Fine demolition, ranchers.
I felt that in my chips.
buried: Somebody was still down there. The crew will dig them out. Mostly intact.
reminder: Tunnel's still open. They're coming out of it like it's payday.
hold: Night's done but that tunnel's still open. Back down there and blow it!
win: Tunnel's shut and the canyon held. Rest up. Something below is angry.
And the Board's telegram from the strongroom: 'Pell agrees. Shoot the boot, not the foot. Law by spring. Vane.'
That humming? Merely the Queen. Waking. Ah.
lost: The hive got through. Back to the rope, ranchers. We try again.
strongroom: A railroad strongroom, behind the resin! Crates of amber. Mined since 1889, by the look.
And a glass case with a boot in it. Hole straight through the leather. Not a toe touched.
Pell's boot. With a bank receipt in it. They paid the Governor to shoot his own shoe.
And blueprints in a tin: a furnace mortar that sets bugs in amber. Take them.

journal.title: Specimen Notes, No. 7
journal.body:
The tunnel walls were glazed with resin, warm to the touch, and behind them stood a railroad strongroom: amber in crates, ledgers in tins, and Governor Pell's boot under glass, the bullet hole through leather only.

We sealed the tunnel with the railroad's own dynamite. Somewhere below, the humming stopped. Then it began again, louder, and from further down than the tunnel goes.

- E. Whitlow, Rail Car 9

headline_win: Main Tunnel Blown Shut; Ranchers Climb Out Singed but Whole
headline_loss: Tunnel Job Botched; Hive Pours Out of the Hole
